description: This Java source file defines the custom exception class GatewayAuthenticationFailedException used to indicate failed authentication in HTTP requests within the project. It provides methods for creating instances from messages, JSON objects, and headers, and includes an internal builder class.

classes.name: GatewayAuthenticationFailedException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating failed authentication during HTTP requests, extending DittoRuntimeException, with static factory methods and a builder class.

classes.name: GatewayAuthenticationFailedException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class providing a fluent API for constructing GatewayAuthenticationFailedException instances.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new mutable builder instance with a message explaining why authentication failed.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an instance of GatewayAuthenticationFailedException from a specified message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON object representing the error.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new GatewayAuthenticationFailedException with updated headers.
